title: Baseline — the end of a sprint with a recorded human decision
description: Art. II (NON-NEGOTIABLE): a baseline MUST NOT close without a recorded human decision. The AI can write and propose any artifact. It cannot sign.

state_hash.description: The hash of the model state when the baseline closed. A later change to the model makes the baseline not valid.

signature.description: The signature is human. By design, there is no field for an agent here.

signed_by.description: The name or the identifier of the person who decided

rationale.description: Why the baseline was accepted. It cannot be empty.

declared_debt.description: If decision=accepted-with-debt: the open items, recorded as debt that you can trace
